descriptive.caption: Whole-year descriptive statistics of the original ten-minute observations (T01). Blank source units are left unspecified.

splits.caption: Chronological partitions after history-related row removal (T02). All dates are in 2017; end times are 23:00.

folds.caption: Expanding-window h24 cross-validation (T02). Training starts on 8 January at 23:00 in every fold; validation begins at 00:00 and ends at 23:00.

baselines.caption: November validation, h24: seasonal baselines, default regressors and RF-P1 (T04). RMSE/MAE are in kW; MAPE is percent.

cv.caption: Default-model development CV, h24 (T05). SD is the sample standard deviation over five folds, not a confidence interval. Errors in kW; MAPE in percent.

cv_variability.caption: Supplementary default CV variability for all four metrics (T05); mean $\pm$ sample SD. RMSE/MAE in kW, MAPE in percent.

tuning.caption: Tuned h24 development CV (T07). RMSE and its SD are in kW. Improvement compares each row with the absolute default model of that family; $\Delta$ rows combine tuning with a target change.

cv_folds.caption: Default h24 RMSE by temporal fold (T05), in kW. Models are ordered by mean fold RMSE; fold boundaries are given in Table~\ref{tab:folds}.

selected_h24.caption: Selected h24 hyperparameters from best\_params.json. Estimator-wrapper prefixes are omitted; floating values are rounded to six decimals. Both target formulations were searched independently.

search_space.caption: Search spaces shared by both horizons and both target formulations (T06). Budgets are per model formulation, not per parameter. Integer limits are inclusive as displayed.

parameters.caption: All selected configurations from the two parameter JSON files. Wrapper prefixes are omitted; floating parameters are rounded to six decimal places here. JSON files retain full precision.

ablation.caption: Feature ablation with fixed D-selected hyperparameters: mean CV RMSE in kW (T09). Missing entries were not run because the residual base is absent.

horizon.caption: Development CV horizon comparison (T10), RMSE in kW: best formulation within each family chosen separately per horizon. LR, DT, RF and XGB use residual targets; SVR uses the absolute target.

test24.caption: December h24 evaluation (T08), ordered by observed RMSE. The CV-selected model is SVR-tuned. This ordering does not redefine selection. RMSE/MAE in kW; skill is RMSE reduction against Naive-24h.

test1.caption: December h1 evaluation (T08), ordered by observed RMSE. The CV-selected model is SVR-tuned. This ordering does not redefine selection. RMSE/MAE in kW; skill is RMSE reduction against Naive-24h.

worst_days.caption: Five largest daily MAEs for the selected h24 SVR (T08). Bias is prediction minus actual; all numerical columns are in kW.

leakage.caption: Four RF diagnostic settings (T12). These rows differ in task and test distribution and must not be treated as a controlled leakage-effect estimate. Errors in kW.

kfold.caption: Post-final RF search diagnostic: 20 candidates per CV strategy (T12b). Optimism is $100(\mathrm{RMSE}_{test}/\mathrm{RMSE}_{CV}-1)$. Errors in kW.

runtime.caption: Recorded h24 refit and whole-test prediction durations for selected representative models (T08). Hardware and thread configuration are not recorded in this table; timings are descriptive.

search_inventory.caption: Audit of all saved searches: number of sampled configurations and selected mean CV RMSE (kW). The row index is zero-based within the CSV data, excluding its header.

dependencies.caption: Recorded experiment dependencies from requirements.txt; Python 3.12 is specified by the repository. These are recorded pins, not a newly reproduced environment.

survey.caption: Repository-authored survey of ten public GitHub projects (docs/kaggle\_survey.csv / T11). Metrics and protocol descriptions are survey transcriptions, not independently reproduced results; targets and metrics vary.
